aboutus.heading: Your Trusted B2B Partner in Commercial Vehicle Components
aboutus.lead: Since 2001, Samer Automotive has been a leading manufacturer and exporter of high-precision spare parts for commercial vehicles, trucks, and trailers.
aboutus.paragraph1: Acting as the global sales and distribution division of Acar Metal, we combine advanced manufacturing capabilities with seamless international trade. From engineering to post-sales support, we supply premium components to distributors across Europe and worldwide.
aboutus.paragraph2: Our strategy is built on long-term partnerships rather than short-term gains. Every component strictly complies with global quality standards, verified by ISO 9001, TÜV, and ADR certifications.

company.heading: Your Trusted B2B Partner in Commercial Vehicle Spare Parts
company.paragraph:
Our company was established in 2001 as an independent sales division of Acar Metal. Its primary goal was to consolidate domestic and international sales, as well as to provide full pre-sales and after-sales support based on market needs at the time. This enabled Acar Metal to focus entirely on manufacturing—prioritizing the three key goals of any manufacturer: developing new products, improving existing lines, and reducing production costs.
Samer Otomotiv strives to market Acar Metal's certified, high-quality products to domestic and international wholesalers, while delivering comprehensive post-sales service.
Having participated in dozens of trade fairs and conducted face-to-face negotiations with hundreds of clients since its founding, our company successfully operates in both local and global markets. Throughout our journey, we have continuously renewed and evolved our operations.

mission.heading: Driving reliable B2B partnerships with quality truck & trailer components.
mission.paragraph:
To deliver the highest standard of service and products to our valued business partners through a principled, honest, and high-quality corporate identity.
To foster long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships and client satisfaction, encouraging all our employees to prioritize lasting cooperation over short-term commercial gains.
To adapt dynamically to evolving market conditions, constantly advancing our mission of leading through innovation within the sector.

vision.heading: Setting global standards in commercial vehicle parts distribution.
vision.paragraph: With customer satisfaction as our core priority, our goal is to enhance our leadership and well-earned reputation. We achieve this by offering high-quality products at competitive prices, maintaining an extensive inventory, and delivering swift service while strictly adhering to professional business ethics.
